_comment: M11-1 C0: out-of-band disposability proof for the integration harness.
The harness refuses to run against any target not listed here. Absence of positive proof is
a refusal, never a pass — refusing only URLs that match one known production host is exactly
the failure mode this file exists to prevent.
Three independent conditions must all hold before anything is truncated:
1. the connection's FULL hostname (minus any -pooler suffix) appears below — a first-label
match would admit ep-<allowlisted-id>.attacker.example, which checks a prefix, not an
2. the harness works only inside the reservedDatabase; and
3. that database carries the ownership marker the harness stamps when it creates it, so a
pre-existing database that merely shares the name is refused rather than truncated.
Editing disposableEndpoints is a human act, deliberately visible in a diff. Do not automate it.

disposableEndpoints.note: Neon dev branch. Confirmed disposable by the repository owner on 2026-07-25; safemolt.com is served from a different endpoint.
